disclaimer: BASELINE ONLY: no trained RL policy, MPC, or perfect-foresight oracle is included, and these legacy/open-loop diagnostic arms do not share the full V2 information set. Results validate task discrimination and evaluation wiring; they do not establish RL performance, optimality, or commercial superiority.

information_sets.heuristic: latest one-minute V2 telemetry plus safety constraints; no preceding-interval aggregate, delivery context, or issued forecast
information_sets.idle: constant action; observes no environment information
information_sets.balanced: constant action; observes no environment information
information_sets.production_mix: constant action; observes no environment information

observation_fields.name: solar_available
observation_fields.source: ControlStateV2.boundary.solar_available_kw (latest completed one-minute dispatch sample reported at the current decision boundary; reset uses the initial boundary sample)

observation_fields.name: solar_potential
observation_fields.source: ControlStateV2.boundary.solar_potential_kw (clear-sky value sampled for the latest completed one-minute dispatch; reset uses the initial boundary sample)

observation_fields.name: solar_output_factor
observation_fields.source: V2 controller telemetry solar_available_kw / solar_potential_kw for the latest completed one-minute dispatch sample; zero when clear-sky power is zero

observation_fields.name: solar_trend
observation_fields.source: final one-minute solar dispatch samples reported at the current and previous decision boundaries
observation_fields.normalisation: (latest dispatch-sample kw - previous decision-boundary dispatch-sample kw) / solar.peak_kw, clipped to [-1, 1]

observation_fields.name: battery_power
observation_fields.source: ControlStateV2.previous_interval.battery_power_mean_kw (mean over the previous completed decision interval)

observation_fields.name: electrolyser_load
observation_fields.source: ControlStateV2.previous_interval.electrolyser_load_mean (mean over the previous completed decision interval)

observation_fields.name: electrolyser_online
observation_fields.source: ControlStateV2.boundary.electrolyser_online (status during the latest completed physical interval)

observation_fields.name: electrolyser_health
observation_fields.source: ControlStateV2.boundary.health['electrolyser'] (condition during the latest completed physical interval)

observation_fields.name: dac_load
observation_fields.source: ControlStateV2.previous_interval.dac_load_mean (mean over the previous completed decision interval)

observation_fields.name: dac_online
observation_fields.source: ControlStateV2.boundary.dac_online (status during the latest completed physical interval)

observation_fields.name: dac_health
observation_fields.source: ControlStateV2.boundary.health['dac'] (condition during the latest completed physical interval)

observation_fields.name: methanator_load
observation_fields.source: ControlStateV2.previous_interval.methanator_load_mean (mean over the previous completed decision interval)

observation_fields.name: methanator_online
observation_fields.source: ControlStateV2.boundary.methanator_online (status during the latest completed physical interval)

observation_fields.name: methanator_health
observation_fields.source: ControlStateV2.boundary.health['methanator'] (condition during the latest completed physical interval)

observation_fields.name: h2_production
observation_fields.source: ControlStateV2.previous_interval.h2_production_mean_kg_h (mean over the previous completed decision interval)

observation_fields.name: co2_production
observation_fields.source: ControlStateV2.previous_interval.co2_capture_mean_kg_h (mean over the previous completed decision interval)

observation_fields.name: ch4_production
observation_fields.source: ControlStateV2.previous_interval.ch4_production_mean_kg_h (mean over the previous completed decision interval)

observation_fields.name: episode_progress
observation_fields.source: PlantEnvV2 decision counter at current decision boundary

observation_fields.name: delivery_time_to_next
observation_fields.normalisation: remaining physics ticks / delivery-period ticks, clipped to [0, 1]

observation_fields.name: delivery_inventory_coverage
observation_fields.source: ControlStateV2.boundary.ch4_level_kg (current boundary inventory), next requested delivery
observation_fields.normalisation: CH4 kg / next requested kg, clipped to [0, 2]

observation_fields.name: delivery_fill_rate_to_date
observation_fields.normalisation: delivered kg / requested kg; 1 before the first deadline

observation_fields.name: solar_forecast_0_1h_p10
observation_fields.normalisation: identity (10th ensemble percentile after member-wise window aggregation, divided by solar.peak_kw)

observation_fields.name: solar_forecast_1_6h_p10
observation_fields.normalisation: identity (10th ensemble percentile after member-wise window aggregation, divided by solar.peak_kw)

observation_fields.name: solar_forecast_6_12h_p10
observation_fields.normalisation: identity (10th ensemble percentile after member-wise window aggregation, divided by solar.peak_kw)

observation_fields.name: solar_forecast_12_24h_p10
observation_fields.normalisation: identity (10th ensemble percentile after member-wise window aggregation, divided by solar.peak_kw)

timing.time_semantics: observe boundary t; hold one decision over [t,t+decision_interval); settle a deadline after production in its final physical interval; expose only the causal forecast issued at t with half-open lead windows
timing.flow_sampling_semantics: timestamp and inventories are current after the preceding decision interval; solar availability/potential/output factor and equipment health/online state are the final one-minute dispatch sample in that interval; power, load, and production are time-weighted means over the whole interval (reset uses the initial boundary sample because no interval exists)
timing.guard_semantics: controllers decide from causal boundary telemetry; before every physical step the actuator guard applies absolute kW caps against the simulator-owned solar bus that same step will dispatch
timing.episode_end_semantics: the configured contract horizon is an intrinsic finite-horizon termination (terminated=true, truncated=false); terminal inventory is valued once and value functions must not bootstrap beyond the final observation
